readings: For each invoice, average its nonmissing derived_product_cost values. Separately, calculate derived_total_cost / product_price for each line where both values are present and product_price is nonzero, then average those line ratios to get the invoice ratio. Average the defined invoice ratios across all invoices. Select invoices whose ratio exceeds that overall average. In one row, report the average of the selected invoices’ defined average product costs, the average of their ratios, and the average amount by which their ratios exceed the overall average. Do not round.

For each invoice, average its nonmissing derived_product_cost values. Define its ratio as the sum of its nonmissing derived_total_cost values divided by the sum of its nonmissing product_price values; exclude invoices with an undefined ratio or a zero denominator. Average the defined invoice ratios across all invoices. Select invoices whose ratio exceeds that overall average. In one row, report the average of the selected invoices’ defined average product costs, the average of their ratios, and the average amount by which their ratios exceed the overall average. Do not round.

For each invoice, average its nonmissing derived_product_cost values. Define its ratio as its average nonmissing derived_total_cost divided by its average nonmissing product_price; exclude invoices with an undefined ratio or a zero denominator. Average the defined invoice ratios across all invoices. Select invoices whose ratio exceeds that overall average. In one row, report the average of the selected invoices’ defined average product costs, the average of their ratios, and the average amount by which their ratios exceed the overall average. Do not round.
queries:
WITH invoice_averages AS (
    SELECT
        i.invoice_number,
        AVG(l.derived_product_cost) AS avg_product_cost,
        AVG(
            CASE
                WHEN l.derived_total_cost IS NOT NULL
                 AND l.product_price IS NOT NULL
                 AND l.product_price <> 0
                THEN CAST(l.derived_total_cost AS REAL) / l.product_price
            END
        ) AS invoice_ratio
    FROM Invoices AS i
    LEFT JOIN Invoice_Line_Items AS l
        ON l.invoice_number = i.invoice_number
    GROUP BY i.invoice_number
),
overall_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(invoice_ratio) AS overall_ratio
    FROM invoice_averages
)
SELECT
    AVG(a.avg_product_cost),
    AVG(a.invoice_ratio),
    AVG(a.invoice_ratio - o.overall_ratio)
FROM invoice_averages AS a
CROSS JOIN overall_average AS o
WHERE a.invoice_ratio > o.overall_ratio

WITH invoice_stats AS (
    SELECT
        i.invoice_number,
        AVG(li.derived_product_cost) AS avg_product_cost,
        SUM(li.derived_total_cost) AS total_cost,
        SUM(li.product_price) AS total_price
    FROM Invoices AS i
    LEFT JOIN Invoice_Line_Items AS li
        ON li.invoice_number = i.invoice_number
    GROUP BY i.invoice_number
),
invoice_ratios AS (
    SELECT
        avg_product_cost,
        1.0 * total_cost / total_price AS ratio
    FROM invoice_stats
    WHERE total_cost IS NOT NULL
      AND total_price IS NOT NULL
      AND total_price <> 0
),
overall AS (
    SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio
    FROM invoice_ratios
)
SELECT
    AVG(ir.avg_product_cost),
    AVG(ir.ratio),
    AVG(ir.ratio - o.avg_ratio)
FROM invoice_ratios AS ir
CROSS JOIN overall AS o
WHERE ir.ratio > o.avg_ratio

WITH invoice_averages AS (
    SELECT
        invoice_number,
        AVG(derived_product_cost) AS avg_product_cost,
        AVG(derived_total_cost) AS avg_total_cost,
        AVG(product_price) AS avg_product_price
    FROM Invoice_Line_Items
    GROUP BY invoice_number
),
invoice_ratios AS (
    SELECT
        avg_product_cost,
        avg_total_cost / avg_product_price AS ratio
    FROM invoice_averages
    WHERE avg_total_cost IS NOT NULL
      AND avg_product_price IS NOT NULL
      AND avg_product_price <> 0
),
overall AS (
    SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio
    FROM invoice_ratios
)
SELECT
    AVG(i.avg_product_cost),
    AVG(i.ratio),
    AVG(i.ratio - o.avg_ratio)
FROM invoice_ratios AS i
CROSS JOIN overall AS o
WHERE i.ratio > o.avg_ratio
